summary_text: TSM surged 6% to $418.03 (fresh 52-week high) on AMD's blowout Q1 2026 earnings (May 5, 2026; revenue $10.3B +38% YoY, non-GAAP EPS $1.37 vs $1.27). TSMC is AMD's primary manufacturer for AI accelerators/server CPUs. TSMC's 2nm capacity to grow at 70% CAGR to 2028 with 5 fabs in volume production this year. CEO C.C. Wei: AI demand 'extremely robust', 2026 capex at upper end of $52-56B target. Bloomberg: Apple in early talks with Intel/Samsung to manufacture device processors but nothing ordered.
